_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Installation Control Drawings
summary: Installation Control Drawings provide data for installing activities to develop plans and drawings for the installation of electronic systems and its associated equipment.
description_purpose: Installation Control Drawings provide data for installing activities to develop plans and drawings for the installation of electronic systems and its associated equipment.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the Installation Control Drawings resulting from the work task described by 3.3 of MIL-D-23140.

This DID is applicable to the acquisition of electronic systems and equipment.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and date of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Installation Control Drawings shall be in the format specified in MIL-D-23140.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Installation Control Drawings shall set forth the electrical, physical, mechanical, and interface data for installation activities to develop plans and drawings for the installation of electronic systems and equipment. Specific content requirements shall be as specified in 3.3.6 through 3.3.15 of MIL-D-23140.

children.title: Types of drawings.
children.content: The specific type(s) of drawings shall be as specified in the contract.
